turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy? This is Vikram from the Delhi Customs Clearance wing.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I am Reddy. Is something wrong? Why are you calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, we have intercepted a courier package arriving for you from abroad, but it contains banned items and is currently held at the airport.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Banned items? I have not ordered anything from outside. This must be a mistake.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is why we need to clear this immediately. If you do not settle the penalty, the police will be sent to your home for questioning.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Police? Please, I do not know about any package. What can I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To avoid the legal case and release the hold, you need to pay a clearance fine of nine thousand five hundred rupees now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Nine thousand five hundred? That is a lot of money. Can I come to the office and pay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, the office is closed for auditing. You must pay it via UPI or get a Google Play gift card right now to stop the police action.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I do not know how to use these gift cards. Can I pay by cheque?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No cheques, Mr. Reddy. Please just send the UPI payment to this number I will message you, or the case will be registered in ten minutes.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ten minutes? Let me call my son first and ask him.
